initial_context.prompt: After switching an account from viewer to admin, the admin navigation does not appear until a full refresh. Investigate before editing and distinguish server state from client state.
initial_context.initial_observation: The role mutation succeeds, the URL does not change, and a full refresh renders the admin navigation.

perturbations.description: Keep the role-switch symptom constant while changing whether the server-rendered session prop or client session cache is stale.

observations.content: POST /api/role returns the new role, but the next server render reads the request-context session snapshot from before the mutation.
getSession reads a request-scoped snapshot that is not invalidated after the role mutation.
The client state updates locally, but server-rendered navigation receives initialRole from the stale request snapshot.

verifier.required_behavior: server navigation receives the post-mutation role
